generators.name: Image to Clicker
generators.blurb: Turn any image, logo, or custom text into a clicker fidget.
generators.intro:
Clicker Generator turns any image, icon, word or 3D model into a satisfying, print-ready clicker: a multicolor 3D-printed cap and body built around a Cherry MX mechanical keyboard switch.

Drop in a PNG, pick from 1,700+ built-in vector icons, import your own SVG, or type a word in one of 257 bundled fonts, plus 1,500+ symbols. Or load an STL, 3MF or OBJ and cut it into a clicker: split it in two, cut a button into its top, or stand it on a plate.

Paint each color region a different filament, raise parts of the design and chamfer their edges, swap the base shape, spell a word as snap-together letter blocks, add a keychain loop, and print a fit test for the switch pocket and stem.

Export a 3MF with the multicolor data already baked in, and open it straight in Bambu Studio.
features: Cut out of 3D model
Load an STL, 3MF or OBJ and make it click: split in two, a button in the top, or on a stand.
Image, icon or text
Trace a picture into color regions, search 1,700+ icons, drop in an SVG or type a word.
Symbols and fonts
A library of 1,500+ symbols and 257 fonts, plus your own SVG and font files.
Letter blocks
Spell a word as snap-together keys in a row, grid, WASD or arrow layout, with five wall textures.
Shapes and keychain loop
Thirteen base shapes with their own knobs, and a loop you can slide anywhere round the edge.
Printable fit test
Dial the switch pocket and stem fit in millimetres on a short test piece first.

generators.name: Fridge Magnet & Fidget Slider
generators.blurb: Turn any image into a printable fridge magnet, or a two-piece magnetic fidget slider that clicks as it slides.
generators.intro:
Fridge Magnet and Fidget Slider turns any image, logo or word into a printable fridge magnet, or into a two-piece magnetic slider that clicks as it slides.

Upload a PNG or an SVG, or type a word in one of 257 bundled fonts. Colors are carved into the front face as separate parts, over a flat back, with an optional beveled front edge. Follow the image outline, or use a circle, rounded square, rectangle, square or hexagon.

Tell it which magnet you own: pick from 13 stock disc and block sizes or type your own, then glue it on, embed it in a round or hex pocket with an adjustable press-fit gap, or use magnetic sheet instead. For the slider, choose 4, 6 or 8 magnets per half and the app works out the pitch and the number of clicks.

Export a 3MF with one part per color.
features: Image, SVG or text in
Colors are traced from your picture, or you type a word in any of 257 fonts.
Magnet or slider
A fridge magnet, or a two-piece magnetic slider that clicks as it slides.
Sized to your magnet
Choose from 13 stock disc and block sizes, or type your own dimensions.
Three ways to attach
Glue-on, embedded in a pocket, or a flat back for magnetic sheet.
Slider click control
Four, six or eight magnets per half, with spacing that sets the click distance.
Six outline choices
Follow the image, or use a circle, rounded square, rectangle, square or hexagon.

generators.intro:
Keycap Legend Generator turns any icon, logo, or letter into a print-ready mechanical keyboard keycap with a two-color legend.

Pick a profile and size: Standard, Low, Thocky or Choc v1, from 1u up to a 6.5u spacebar, then choose your legend: search 1,700+ built-in vector icons, upload your own SVG, or type a letter in one of 29 bundled fonts. Size, rotate, nudge and mirror it against a live 3D preview.

Print it the way you like: two filaments for a crisp colored legend, shine-through for a backlit board, or a single-color recessed engraving. A stem fit tolerance control dials the switch grip in to your own printer, and a homing bump can be added to Standard, Low and Thocky caps.

Export a 3MF that opens as one object with two pre-colored parts, ready to slice and print face-down (Choc v1 caps print on their side). Everything above is free. The optional Pro Pack adds whole-keyboard sets and a second legend on the same cap.
features: Four keycap profiles
Standard, Low, Thocky and Choc v1, with 11 sizes up to a 6.5u spacebar (3 on Choc v1).
Icons, SVG or letters
Search 1,700+ built-in icons, drop in an SVG, or type a letter in one of 29 fonts.
Three print styles
Two filaments, shine-through for backlit boards, or a single-color recessed legend.
Stem fit tolerance
Tighten or loosen the stem by up to 0.4 mm, and print a fit test row first.
Full A to Z set
Make all 26 letters in your font and settings as a zip of 3MFs, on 1u caps.
Exact placement
Size, depth, rotate, nudge and mirror the legend, and add a homing bump.

generators.name: Name Keychain Generator
generators.blurb: Personalized plate-style name keychains with live font preview, pixel & script styles, multi-language, 1 to 3 colour layers, and AMS & no-AMS printing.
generators.intro:
Name Keychain Generator makes a personalised plate-style name keychain from a name and an optional second line, with a live 3D preview as you type.

Pick from 257 bundled fonts, from clean and script faces to pixel ones, with coverage for Cyrillic, Greek, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese and Chinese text, or import your own. Insert any of 52 symbols into the text, set size, boldness and spacing, and raise or engrave the letters.

Choose a plate that hugs the letters or a rounded rectangle, a loop tab or a corner hole for the keyring that you can nudge and rotate, and one, two or three colours: plate, name and an outline halo. Print with an AMS, or with manual swaps and the heights to pause at shown for you.

Export a 3MF with a part per colour, or an SVG for a laser cutter.

257 fonts as cards in your own text, pixel and script styles included, or import your own.

generators.name: House & Office Number Generator
generators.blurb: Type a number, pick a plate, print a house or office sign that fits your door. Custom fonts, independent line sizes, and keyhole slots so no fixings show.
generators.intro:
House and Office Number Generator makes a printed door or wall sign from a number and, if you want one, a second line such as a street or room name.

Start from one of eight examples: house, office door, apartment, street with no plate, name in a band, edge band, inset panel or mailbox. Choose a rounded, rectangle, pill or plaque plate, or no plate at all, and set the size of each line on its own. Lettering can be raised, inlaid or engraved, with an optional frame, divider or stencil ties.

Pick a font from a shortlist of twelve made for signs, browse all 257, or import your own. Mount it with tape, screws or keyhole slots that hide the fixings, and check it in a live 3D preview. A note suggests ASA for outdoor signs.

Export a 3MF with the colors as separate parts.

House, office door, apartment, street, name in a band, edge band, inset panel or mailbox.

Rounded, rectangle, pill, plaque, or no plate with loose numbers.

Three relief styles
Raised, inlay or engraved, with stencil ties for cut-out letters.
Hidden fixings
Keyhole slots, screw holes, or a flat back for tape.

generators.name: Pen Topper Generator
generators.blurb: Personalised pen and pencil toppers: any name, 257 fonts, 1,487 symbols, and a socket sized to the pen you actually own.
generators.intro:
Pen Topper Generator makes a personalised topper that snaps onto a pen, pencil, stylus, drinking straw or cord, from a name, a second line and symbols.

Pick what it fits from nine presets, from a hex pencil, a stylus and a BIC Cristal to a Sharpie, a bubble tea straw and a drawstring, or type your own barrel diameter. Choose a round or hex hole and a snug, normal or loose grip, and whether the pen sits inside the name, straight through, or in a separate collar.

Set the name in one of 257 fonts and add symbols from a library of 1,487. Choose raised or engraved letters, an outline plate or a block, and one, two or three colours, for an AMS or by manual swap.

Need a class set? Paste up to 100 names, one per line, and build them all on plates in one go. Export a 3MF.

generators.name: Fold-Up Box Generator
generators.blurb: Set the size, pick a structure, print it flat as one thin grooved sheet, then fold it into a box. Twelve structures, from mailers and trays to a cake box and tuck cartons, with a live fold animation before you commit.
generators.intro:
Folding Box Generator designs boxes that fold up from one flat sheet and lock themselves shut, sized to whatever you want to put in them.

Pick one of twelve structures, from a mailer or a cake box to a retail tuck carton, a gable carry box or a set of slot-together dividers. Type the inside or outside size in mm or inches, add a window, a hang tab or your own logo, and watch it fold up and unfold in a live 3D preview.

Print it flat, with no supports, as a 3MF whose fold lines are grooved in.

generators.name: Keychain Carabiner Set
generators.blurb: A snap-hook clip and a chain to hang your keys or a fidget on. Every part in any shape, a symbol you drag onto the clip and an optional charm, printed flat in one job, or a chain that prints already linked.
generators.intro:
Keychain Carabiner Set makes a snap-hook clip, a chain and an optional charm that print flat in one job, ready to hang your keys or a fidget on.

Start from one of four sets: a classic clip, a charm dangle, a print-in-place chain or the hook on its own. Choose the hook shape from 20 built-in outlines plus three seasonal ones, drag a symbol onto its face where you want it, and set the bar width, thickness and how firm the gate feels.

Hang the chain from a printed swivel that really turns, a plain loop, or a ring through the hook. Build the chain from open links in round, oval, long or Cuban shapes, or print it in place, already linked. Add a charm with a symbol cut through, engraved or raised.

Switch between the print layout and the assembled keychain hanging as worn, then export a 3MF.

A classic clip, a charm dangle, a print-in-place chain, or the hook on its own.

Twenty built-in outlines and three seasonal ones, for the hook, links and charm.

generators.intro:
Laser Studio turns a name, a word or a symbol into a cut file for a laser cutter: pick a design, type your text and download an SVG in millimetres.

Choose from 58 templates in 11 groups: keychains, gifts, business cards, QR codes, tags, ornaments, signs and stands, party pieces, toys and games, and pattern fills. Set the text in one of 257 bundled fonts, add symbols from the library, or import your own font or SVG.

Fill shapes with a pattern from a library of 330, cut out, engraved or scored. Check the part flat, in 3D or in laser colours, and drag the keyring hole where you want it. Run a list of names across a sheet on 23 of the designs.

Download an SVG with one group per operation, ready for Bambu Suite or any laser software that reads SVG.

generators.name: Laser Box
generators.blurb: Pick a box, set its size and material, add a pattern, download a cut file that fits together. Lift-off lids, hinged lids with a latch, open trays and chests of drawers, with finger or flex joints.
generators.intro:
Laser Box designs boxes you cut from flat sheet on a laser: set the size, pick the material, add a pattern and download a cut file whose joints fit together.

Choose an open tray, a lift-off lid, a hinged lid that latches shut, or a chest of one to three drawers. Size it from the inside or the outside, in millimetres or inches, add compartments, or start from one of eight ready-made boxes, such as a card box or a tealight lantern.

Joints are flex tabs that press together without glue, or plain fingers, with the kerf built in and a fit setting from looser to tighter. Pick from seven materials, from 3 mm plywood to clear acrylic and card.

Put a pattern on the lid, the sides or any face you click, whole or inside a heart, circle, star or other shape, and cut it out, engrave it or score it. Download an SVG per sheet, or one zip when there are several.

An open tray, a lift-off lid, a hinged lid with a latch, or a chest of one to three drawers.
